title: KLAC's Backlog Surges on AI Demand: Can It Outpace AMAT & ASML?
author: Na
description: KLA Corporation's backlog surged to $12.57B, driven by AI infrastructure investments and semiconductor demand. The company expects advanced-packaging revenues to reach $1.1B in 2026, up 70% year-over-year. However, KLAC faces intense competition from Applied Materials and ASML, with the stock trading at a premium valuation and holding a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong backlog growth to $12.57B, driven by AI infrastructure buildout; advanced-packaging revenues expected to grow 70% YoY; improved revenue visibility and market share positioning support continued growth into 2027.
Benefiting from same AI-driven semiconductor equipment upcycle; process diagnostics business expected to grow over 50% in 2026; expanding manufacturing capacity to double quarterly output by 2028.
Strong growth expected across all segments in 2026 (advanced foundry/logic +25%, memory +75%, EUV +45%); planning significant capacity expansions for Low-NA EUV in 2027 and 2028.

title: ASML reports transactions under its current share buyback program
author: Na
description: ASML Holding N.V. reports share repurchase transactions conducted between September 21-25, 2026, under its current buyback program announced on January 28, 2026. The company repurchased a total of 165,200 shares across five trading days at weighted average prices ranging from €1,479.91 to €1,533.55 per share, totaling approximately €248.16 million.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The article reports routine share buyback transactions as part of an announced program. Share buybacks are generally viewed as a neutral to slightly positive signal of management confidence, but this is a standard regulatory disclosure with no new strategic information or material developments. The consistent execution of the program at stable prices reflects normal capital allocation activity.

title: Prediction: Micron Will Crush Earnings And...
author: Geoffrey Seiler
description: Micron Technology is expected to report strong fiscal Q4 earnings driven by the AI-driven memory supercycle, with surging demand for DRAM and NAND. However, despite blowout results, the stock may not rally significantly as investors are increasingly concerned about when the memory supercycle will end. Micron's lower HBM market share (18% vs competitors' 50%+ shares) makes it more exposed to potential pullbacks in conventional DRAM and NAND prices.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While Micron is positioned for strong earnings due to favorable supply-demand dynamics in the memory market, the article suggests the stock may not benefit from the earnings beat. Investors are increasingly wary of the supercycle's duration, and Micron's lower HBM market share (18%) compared to competitors makes it more vulnerable to price pullbacks in conventional DRAM and NAND.

SK Hynix has a 50% market share in HBM production, significantly higher than Micron's 18%, positioning it better to benefit from the high-margin HBM demand driven by AI chip companies seeking long-term supply agreements.

ASML is the sole manufacturer of extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machines critical for HBM production, creating a significant bottleneck that benefits the company as demand for these machines surges with the memory supercycle.

title: Nvidia and AMD Can't Make AI Chips Without This Growth Stock. Here's Why It Could Soar.
author: Harsh Chauhan
description: ASML, a Dutch semiconductor equipment maker, holds a monopoly on extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machines essential for manufacturing advanced AI chips. With Nvidia and AMD relying on ASML's technology through foundries like TSMC, the company is positioned to benefit from surging demand for AI infrastructure and memory chips, expecting 25% growth in foundry/logic sales and 75% growth in memory system sales in 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: ASML holds a monopoly in EUV lithography with strong growth prospects. The company expects 25% growth in foundry/logic sales and 75% growth in memory sales in 2026, driven by AI chip demand. Stock has risen 60% in 2026 and trades at reasonable 28x forward earnings with long-term EPS growth expected over 30% annually.

title: ASML (ASML) Surpasses Market Returns: Some Facts Worth Knowing
author: Na
description: ASML rose 1.87% to $1,711.32 in the latest session, outperforming the S&P 500's 1.49% gain. However, the semiconductor equipment supplier has declined 4.75% over the past month. Ahead of its October 14, 2026 earnings report, analysts expect $12.54 EPS (95.63% YoY growth) and $13.18B revenue (49.99% growth). ASML carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) with a Forward P/E of 38.09, trading at a premium to its industry average of 30.75.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While ASML shows strong expected earnings growth (95.63% YoY) and revenue growth (49.99% YoY), the stock has underperformed over the past month (-4.75%) and carries a Hold rating (Zacks Rank #3). The Forward P/E of 38.09 is at a premium to industry average, suggesting the positive growth expectations may already be priced in. Recent analyst estimate revisions have been slightly negative (-1.67% over 30 days).
